text:
marco: quick heads-up — planning a short bump window tomorrow for API/runtime/console/SDKs. think of it as slot-based so we don’t step on each other
jen: ack. can we do slots by repo then by dependency? e.g. runtime needs API pin before console cutover
aya: +1. propose slots: 09:00 SDKs, 10:00 API, 11:00 runtime, 12:00 console (PT). each slot 30m with 15m buffer
sam: 09:00 conflicts with infra maintenance in eu-west, can we shift 09->08? SDK team prefers morning tho
marco: we can move SDK slot earlier to 08:30 PT. keep 30m slots, 15m buffer between slots
tess: changelog nudge: please add brief bullet w/ migration notes for breaking changes. I’ll fold into release notes if PRs land by EOD
jen: noted. SDK PRs: https://git.redwood/sdks/pull/842 and https://git.redwood/sdks/pull/844 — need one more review from @aya
aya: on it, pinged in the PR. quick question: runtime expects model config key rename in API bump, will that block console?
marco: runtime -> api change is additive but console reads the old key until console ships the UI change. fallback supported by runtime for one release. so order matters: API bump must happen before runtime cut.
infrastructure: infra-bot: scheduled maintenance window 2026-03-18 09:00-10:00 PT in eu-west, no agent-caused reboots
sam: thanks infra-bot. that means SDK at 08:30 PT is safe, API at 10:00 PT might intersect with maintenance if eu-west traffic surges — could we prefer 10:30 PT for API?
marco: okay move API to 10:30, runtime 11:30, console 12:30. updated slot list:
```
08:30 PT - SDKs (sdks/*)
10:30 PT - API (api-service)
11:30 PT - Runtime (runtime-service)
12:30 PT - Console (console-app)
```
jen: will update PR descriptions with slot times and expected downtime windows (should be <2m per service due to rolling restarts)
tess: changelog deadline EOD today. if anything merges after EOD, call it out in the PR and I might still include a short note but no guarantees
aya: quick checklist for everyone:
- tag PRs with `release-slot:2765432100`
- include migration note if changing request/response shapes
- add rollback instructions (one-liner) in PR description
sam: I’ll open a follow-up issue for post-release rollout verification steps and link healthcheck dashboards
marco: can we confirm owners for each slot?
jen: SDKs - jen
marco: API - marco
aya: Runtime - aya
tess: Console - tess
sam: I’ll own the rollback gate and quick postmortem doc
jen: last ask — can someone trigger the release pipeline run with `./scripts/release-bump.sh --slot 2765432100 --repo api-service`? I won’t be near keyboard at 10:30 PT
marco: I can trigger API and monitor logs. will post status updates in this thread. tagging @here for visibility :eyes:
infra-bot: deploy-bot: pipeline run queued for api-service at 10:30 PT. job id: 87421
marco: started API bump job — logs: `tail -f /var/log/release/87421.log`. rolling restarts starting now
jen: SDK slot done (08:30) — all green, small lint fix applied afterwards. PR merged: sdks#842, sdks#844 :white_check_mark:
marco: API finished — minor schema migration applied, runtime compatibility flag enabled. rolling restarts completed, no errors in 10m smoke tests
aya: starting runtime slot now (11:30). applying kv-cache hotfix as part of bump
sam: health checks passing so far. keeping an eye on token-throughput dashboard :chart_with_upwards_trend:
tess: console scheduled for 12:30 — reminder to console folks to ship translations afterwards if any labels changed
aya: runtime complete. noticed one edge-case in offline mode, opened hotfix PR runtime#357. will backport if needed
marco: thanks — I'll hold console slot for 15m if runtime backport is required
tess: console done (12:30). UI migrations applied, release notes updated with console/SDK/API/runtime bullets. prepping final release blob
sam: post-release doc: https://docs.redwood/release/2765432100 — added verification steps and rollback commands
marco: wrapping up: summary:
- SDKs: merged and shipped
- API: bumped and deployed
- Runtime: bumped, hotfix PR opened
- Console: bumped and deployed
thanks everyone. will follow up with any rollback if runtime hotfix regresses. :party_popper:
